decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the firm's core cheese offer, cost little to sustain, and was promoted to its own page in 2019, so management stays committed despite the lack of later evidence.
As a multi-model spicy cheese line with its own page, it represents a larger visible investment, which management would rather justify and keep than write off.
The firm publicly announced the mild creamy soft cheese as the product that rounded off its new range and gave it its own page, so dropping it would expose that earlier commitment as a mistake.
